title: Client update bundles send RatchetTreeOption distributionService, not full; full only where a joiner needs it
description:
Decision 2026-11-14 (Mark). A client's §5.3 update HandshakeBundle carries ratchetTreeOption = distributionService (ratchet-tree-options-02), not the full tree. Why: a mimid hub rebuilds the tree from the Commits it accepts and attaches its own to Welcome fan-out (decision mimid-1wgh.6.12, hub/update.rs), and Haven's mimi-hubd reads no tree. So a full tree in the update was uploaded on every Commit and never used. It's a few hundred bytes per member: about doubling a two-person Commit bundle, and hundreds of KB per Commit at a thousand members.

Keep full where a joiner needs it: the Welcome a client delivers itself when the hub keeps no tree (mimid-chat against mimi-hubd: FanoutEvent::Welcome with RatchetTreeOption::full), and the hub's own Welcome fan-out.

Done in mimid-chat on 2026-11-14 (commit_request in tools/interop/chat/src/chat.rs; acceptance.sh passed against haven.reviewcommit.com, run tag t20261114172222). To do: carry the same rule into mimid-agent's design (this bead's parent), and check that mimid's hub doesn't come to rely on a client-sent tree.

Follow-up, not now: GroupInfoOption partial instead of full would shrink bundles too, but no other implementation has PartialGroupInfo (Haven DIV-12), so leave it until there is a second implementation.
close_reason: Both halves hold (checked 2026-11-16): mimid-agent-core commit_request sends RatchetTreeOption distributionService (agent.rs, cites this bead), and the agent's two-agent and JMAP tests pass against mimid's hub with it. The hub never reads the client's tree: hub/update.rs takes the tree from its own observer (L554) for the Welcome fan-out as full (L588), and group_info.rs serves its own snapshot. mimid-chat did the same 2026-11-14.
